feed_items.postgres:
select p.id as item_id, p.id as post_id, null::bigint as reposter_id, p.user_id as author_id,
		p.reply_to_id is not null as is_reply, p.created_at
	from posts p
	union all
	select r.id, r.post_id, r.user_id, r.user_id, false, r.created_at
	from reposts r
